output.title: IP commonName handling change may alter issued Certificate SANs
output.content: v1.18.0 stops adding IP addresses in commonName to the DNS subjectAlternativeName list and adds them to ipAddresses instead. The environment uses cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate manifests, but the summary does not show their commonName values. Inspect your Certificate resources for an IP address in commonName and whether consumers rely on it appearing as a DNS SAN.
